items.label: Process view
items.text: The Process view stays after a run, so you can read what happened.

items.label: Elapsed time
items.text: The time shown is the real time of this run on your computer.

items.label: One step per controller
items.text: One step per controller, with a plain description of what it does and the time it took. The first step loads the lead-car trace. Below the steps, a log lists the engine's own messages with times; it is a real log, not an animation.
